schema.description:
An Emission Calculation Formula is broken down into components that can be either Activity Type
Parameters, operators (e.g., sum, multiplication, division), or a factor.
schema.title: Emission Calculation Formula Component

emission_factor_physical_quantity_type_i.description: The optional part of a composite Foreign Key identifying the Emission Factor (the Physical Quantity Type).

emission_factor_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Factor used by a Calculation Model.

emission_calculation_component_type.description:
The Emission Calculation Formula Component Type assigned:
Emission Activity Parameter Type Assignment or Emission Factor.

emission_calculation_component_line_id.description: The Primary Key assigned to the Emission Calculation Formula Component.

emission_calculation_component_id.description: The Foreign Key of either an Emission Activity Type Parameter Type Assignment or Emission Factor as the Emission Calculation Formula Component.

emission_factor_parameter_type_id.description: DEPRECATED, replace by Physical Quantity Type. Optional part of a composite foreign key identifying the emission factor. The emission parameter type.

physical_quantity_type_id.description: The optional part of a composite Foreign Key identifying the Emission Activity Type Parameter Type Assignment (the Physical Quantity Type).

emission_calculation_formula_id.description: The Foreign Key of the constructed Emission Calculation Formula.

emission_calculation_component_order.description: The sequential order of the Emission Calculation Formula Component.

emission_factor_type_id.description: The optional part of a composite foreign identifying the Emission Factor (the Emission Factor Type).

emission_activity_type_id.description: The optional part of a composite Foreign Key of the Emission Activity Type Parameter Type Assignment (the Emission Activity Type).

emission_parameter_assignment_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Activity Type Parameter Type Assignment.

emission_parameter_type_id.description: DEPRECATED, replace by the Physical Quantity Type Id. Optional part of a composite foreign key identifying the emission parameter assignment type. The Emission Parameter Type

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.
